newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton ranged after unseasonal rains.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton ranged after unseasonal rains.

text.p: Cotton prices held steady in a narrow price band on the local market on Monday, dealers said.
"Mill demand remained sluggish but scattered supplies kept the market quiet," one dealer said.
"New crop arrivals remained lower than expected following unseasonal rains in the producing centres but traders were expecting this rain to benefit new crop," a broker said.

The new crop will be little a higher compared to the earlier estimate of 16 million bales (170 kg each). In spot deals Bengal-deshi was steady at 920/960 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned was quiet at 1,615/1,750 rupees.
